summary: TechCrunch+ covers Alliance DAO's All11 demo day, where eight web3 startups (six from All11 and two from All10) pitched despite crypto bear-market conditions. The cohort drew 1,083 applications, down 36% from All10's record 1,692, and spans on/off-ramps, trading, NFT gaming, content delivery, wallets, debt markets, security, and encrypted EVMs. Alliance DAO's Qiao Wang called it the most exclusive cohort in its history and said the industry is likely near the bottom of the venture funding cycle.
one_line: Alliance DAO's All11 demo day showcased eight web3 startups across NFTs, security, wallets and more amid a crypto bear market.
key_facts: Alliance DAO's All11 cohort received 1,083 applications, down 36% from All10, which had a record 1,692 applicants.
Only six teams graduated from All11, and two startups from All10 also presented; the last cohort had 16 graduating projects.
Alliance DAO's three-month accelerator requires founders for at least 10 hours per week, runs twice a year, and invests $250,000 in participating startups.
Qiao Wang, a core contributor at Alliance DAO, said, "This is the most exclusive cohort in our history."
Alliance says each startup in the cohort received an average of over 50 intro requests after demo day from VC firms like Paradigm and Multicoin.
Sleepagotchi, an NFT-powered sleep game, has 14,000 monthly active users and a 41% one-year retention rate, and raised $3.5 million in January.
Blockcast says it can cut the cost of streaming a 4K movie to 10,000 viewers (typically about $1,000 via servers like Cloudflare) by 96%.
Upshield launched two weeks before the demo day after two months in beta, has an ARR of $120,000, and offers over 100 web3 threat detectors across eight blockchains and networks.
Tazz is in "discussions with a very large protocol to issue $5 million in debt," according to CEO Alan Hampton.
Inco Network uses fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) for private smart contracts; it is live on DevNet with mainnet launching in 2024.
Kravata is a Colombia-based fiat-to-crypto on/off-ramp for Latin America, backed by Circle Ventures, Framework Ventures and Alliance DAO.
Tailwind founder Bao Mai was previously a founding engineer at JunoSwap; Tailwind is a Cosmos-focused wallet that lets users pick a single gas token.
Wang told TechCrunch the crypto industry is likely near the bottom of the cycle in terms of venture funding and developer activity.
